records.source: Oh! I thought you knew.#$b#This room's for developing photos.
records.translation: Ah! Akala ko ay alam mo.#$b#Para sa pagproseso ng mga litrato ang silid na ito.

records.source: Is that so...?$s
records.translation: Ganoon ba...?$s

records.source: No, you won't! This bracelet was passed down to me by my great-grandmother!$a
records.translation: Hindi, hindi mo gagawin! Ipinamana sa akin ng lola ko sa tuhod ang pulseras na ito!$a

records.source: *sigh*$s#$b#...Maybe it'll wash up on another shore. I can't bear to think of it at the bottom of the ocean.$s
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*$s#$b#...Baka maanod iyon sa ibang pampang. Hindi ko kayang isipin itong nasa ilalim ng karagatan.$s

records.source: Him? No!#$b#...Well, I guess I used to like Alex. But not anymore! He's immature.
records.translation: Siya? Hindi!#$b#...Aba, siguro ay gusto ko noon si Alex. Pero hindi na ngayon! Isip-bata siya.

records.source: What? That sounds fun, but I wouldn't want to leave Stardew Valley right now...
records.translation: Ano? Mukhang masaya iyon, pero ayaw kong umalis sa Stardew Valley ngayon...

records.source: Huh? What's an android?
records.translation: Ha? Ano ang android?

records.source: I'm going to get such a nice tan this summer.
records.translation: Magiging napakaganda ng pagkakaitim ng balat ko ngayong tag-init.

records.source: Ew, you're all dirty.
records.translation: Kadiri, napakarumi mo.

records.source: Um... Yes?#$e#I didn't hear you, I'm thinking about something else.
records.translation: Um... Oo?#$e#Hindi kita narinig, may iba akong iniisip.

records.source: Do you have baby bunnies on your farm? Bunnies are SO cute! <
records.translation: May mga batang kuneho ba sa bukid mo? NAPAKATUTUWA ng mga kuneho! <

records.source: If you stay in the sun a lot it'll make your hair lighter.#$e#It's a good thing to know!
records.translation: Kung madalas kang magbilad sa araw, papusyawin nito ang buhok mo.#$e#Mabuting malaman iyan!

records.source: I wonder what Alex is doing today...#$e#Huh? I didn't notice you standing there.
records.translation: Ano kaya ang ginagawa ni Alex ngayon...#$e#Ha? Hindi ko napansing nakatayo ka riyan.

records.source: Farming sounds so boring...#$q 42/43 summer_Sat_old#What do you even do all day?#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#Care for plants#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#Explore the caves#$r 43 -10 summer_Sat_13#Snoop around in your room#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#Dig for treasure
records.translation: Mukhang napakanakababagot ang pagsasaka...#$q 42/43 summer_Sat_old#Ano ba ang ginagawa mo maghapon?#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#Mag-alaga ng mga halaman#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#Galugarin ang mga yungib#$r 43 -10 summer_Sat_13#Manghimasok sa kuwarto mo#$r 42 10 summer_Sat_12#Maghukay ng kayamanan

records.source: #$p 43#Hey, you better not be snooping around in my room anymore!$a|But I guess it could get you in pretty good shape.
records.translation: #$p 43#Hoy, huwag ka nang manghimasok sa kuwarto ko!$a|Pero siguro ay talagang mapabubuti niyon ang pangangatawan mo.

records.source: Hmm... sounds like a lot of work.
records.translation: Hmm... mukhang napakaraming gawain.

records.source: What? You'd better not be doing that!$a
records.translation: Ano? Huwag na huwag mong gagawin iyon!$a

records.source: Emily usually cooks dinner... But she makes weird stuff like quinoa.
records.translation: Karaniwan ay si Emily ang nagluluto ng hapunan... Pero gumagawa siya ng mga kakaibang bagay tulad ng quinoa.

records.source: Do you wear those clothes every day?
records.translation: Araw-araw mo bang isinusuot ang mga damit na iyan?

records.source: $p 47#Hey I found this new tool to open jars with. So you won't need to help me anymore.$h|There's not a cloud in the sky today.$h
records.translation: $p 47#Hoy, nakakita ako ng bagong kasangkapan para pambukas ng garapon. Kaya hindi mo na kailangang tumulong sa akin.$h|Walang kahit isang ulap sa langit ngayon.$h

records.source: It's so hot today!#$e#I wish I had some ice cream.$s
records.translation: Napakainit ngayon!#$e#Sana ay mayroon akong sorbetes.$s

records.source: I spent 3 hours practicing my signature today.#$e#I guess that's pretty silly, huh?
records.translation: Tatlong oras akong nagsanay ng pirma ko ngayon.#$e#Medyo kalokohan iyon, ano?

records.source: If you stay in the sun a lot it will make your hair lighter... But you don't want to get sunburnt, either.#$e#I just want a healthy amount of sunlight. Everything in moderation, right?
records.translation: Kung madalas kang magbilad sa araw, papusyawin nito ang buhok mo... Pero ayaw mo ring masunog sa araw.#$e#Gusto ko lang ng sapat at ligtas na sikat ng araw. Dapat katamtaman ang lahat, hindi ba?

records.source: I should start reading some books instead of magazines.#$e#It's good to learn things, isn't it?#$e#I only ever look at the pictures.
records.translation: Dapat akong magsimulang magbasa ng mga aklat sa halip na magasin.#$e#Mabuting matuto ng mga bagay, hindi ba?#$e#Mga larawan lang ang lagi kong tinitingnan.

records.source: #$1 HaleySister#I talked to my sister for a while last night. I actually enjoyed it quite a bit.#$e#You know, Emily's not actually that weird. I guess we have more in common than I used to think.#$e#Don't tell her I said so.
records.translation: #$1 HaleySister#Matagal-tagal kaming nag-usap ng kapatid ko kagabi. Talagang nasiyahan ako roon.#$e#Alam mo, hindi naman pala ganoon kakakaiba si Emily. Siguro ay mas marami kaming pagkakatulad kaysa sa dating akala ko.#$e#Huwag mong sabihin sa kaniya na sinabi ko iyon.

records.source: It seems like a good day to go swimming.
records.translation: Mukhang magandang araw upang lumangoy.

records.source: I guess living in the country isn't so bad.#$e#If I lived in the city I might start to miss all the trees.#$e#@, I think I've been hanging out with you too much.$h
records.translation: Siguro ay hindi naman ganoon kasama ang manirahan sa lalawigan.#$e#Kung nakatira ako sa lungsod, baka mangulila ako sa lahat ng puno.#$e#@, sa tingin ko'y masyado na kitang madalas kasama.$h

records.source: Oh, hi @!#$e#Do you like kids?$l
records.translation: Ah, kumusta, @!#$e#Gusto mo ba ang mga bata?$l

records.source: It's fall already?$s
records.translation: Taglagas na agad?$s

records.source: It's gross when all these fallen leaves get slimy.
records.translation: Nakakadiri kapag nagiging malagkit at madulas ang lahat ng nalaglag na dahong ito.

records.source: Hmm... Something smells weird...#$e#You've been working on the farm, huh?
records.translation: Hmm... May kakaibang amoy...#$e#Nagtatrabaho ka sa bukid, ha?

records.source: Oh, hi. Did you want something?
records.translation: Ah, kumusta. May kailangan ka ba?

records.source: I feel the urge to go shopping. *sigh*
records.translation: Gusto kong mamili. *buntong-hininga*

records.source: Is that a grass stain on your knee?#$e#Sorry, I'm allergic to grass.
records.translation: Mantsa ba ng damo iyan sa tuhod mo?#$e#Paumanhin, may alerhiya ako sa damo.

records.source: It's too cold to go to the beach anymore.#$q 44 fall_Sat_old#*sigh*...what do you think I should do today?#$r 44 10 fall_Sat_12#Watercolor painting#$r 44 20 fall_Sat_12#Relax and read a magazine#$r 44 -30 fall_Sat_13#Stop being a selfish crybaby
records.translation: Masyado nang malamig upang pumunta sa dalampasigan.#$q 44 fall_Sat_old#*buntong-hininga*...ano sa tingin mo ang dapat kong gawin ngayon?#$r 44 10 fall_Sat_12#Magpinta gamit ang watercolor#$r 44 20 fall_Sat_12#Magpahinga at magbasa ng magasin#$r 44 -30 fall_Sat_13#Tigilan ang pagiging makasariling iyakin

records.source: I'll probably take a nap later.
records.translation: Malamang ay iidlip ako mamaya.

records.source: Hmm... That's a pretty good idea, actually.
records.translation: Hmm... Magandang ideya nga iyan.

records.source: Get away from me, you stupid jerk.$a
records.translation: Lumayo ka sa akin, hangal na tarantado.$a

records.source: I've never been to the forest. It's muddy and I could get a blister on my foot.
records.translation: Hindi pa ako nakapunta sa kagubatan. Maputik doon at baka magkaroon ako ng paltos sa paa.

records.source: Something smells earthy...#$b#Oh, right. You work on a farm.
records.translation: May amoy-lupa...#$b#Ah, tama. Nagtatrabaho ka sa bukid.

records.source: You look like you've been doing a lot of hard work.#$b#Why don't you take the rest of the day off?
records.translation: Mukhang nagpakahirap ka nang husto.#$b#Bakit hindi ka magpahinga sa natitirang bahagi ng araw?

records.source: If you're ever bored, come say hi.
records.translation: Kung nababagot ka, dumaan ka upang bumati.

records.source: Shopping just doesn't sound as fun as it used to.#$e#What's happening to me?#$e#Hmm...
records.translation: Hindi na mukhang kasingsaya ng dati ang pamimili.#$e#Ano ang nangyayari sa akin?#$e#Hmm...

records.source: $p 48#Did I ever tell you I found another one of my great-grandma's bracelets in the attic?|See this bracelet? It belonged to my great-grandmother.#$e#She was a really interesting lady.
records.translation: $p 48#Nasabi ko na ba sa iyong nakakita ako ng isa pang pulseras ng lola ko sa tuhod sa atik?|Nakikita mo ang pulseras na ito? Pag-aari ito ng lola ko sa tuhod.#$e#Talagang kawili-wili siyang babae.

records.source: I've never been to the forest, you know.#$e#It might be interesting to explore it some day.
records.translation: Hindi pa ako nakapunta sa kagubatan, alam mo.#$e#Baka kawili-wiling galugarin iyon balang araw.

records.source: I'm starting to like the smell of dirt. Isn't that weird?#$e#I think it's because you're around all the time.$h
records.translation: Nagsisimula nang magustuhan ko ang amoy ng lupa. Hindi ba kakaiba iyon?#$e#Sa tingin ko'y dahil lagi kang nasa paligid.$h

records.source: @, I'm happy to see you today.$h
records.translation: @, masaya akong makita ka ngayon.$h

records.source: I want to move somewhere warmer.
records.translation: Gusto kong lumipat sa mas mainit na lugar.

records.source: Hi. Do you need something from me?#$e#...
records.translation: Kumusta. May kailangan ka ba sa akin?#$e#...

records.source: Hmm. What brand is your shirt?#$e#Oh. Um, never mind.
records.translation: Hmm. Anong tatak ng kamiseta mo?#$e#Ah. Um, huwag na.

records.source: I wish someone would bring me a peppermint coffee.$s#$e#Don't even bother, I know you won't be able to make one.
records.translation: Sana ay may magdala sa akin ng kapeng menta.$s#$e#Huwag ka nang mag-abala, alam kong hindi mo kayang gumawa niyon.

records.source: I'm going to start writing a list of all the clothes I need for next spring.
records.translation: Magsisimula akong gumawa ng talaan ng lahat ng damit na kailangan ko sa susunod na tagsibol.

records.source: Do you have a pony on your farm?$h#$e#Oh. That's disappointing...$s
records.translation: May poni ka ba sa bukid mo?$h#$e#Ah. Nakalulungkot naman...$s

records.source: The only good thing about winter is that I get to sleep more.#$e#I like at least 10 hours of sleep every night.
records.translation: Ang tanging magandang bagay sa taglamig ay mas marami akong tulog.#$e#Gusto ko ng kahit sampung oras na tulog gabi-gabi.

records.source: Will you say hi to Alex for me?#$e#Thanks.
records.translation: Maaari mo bang kumustahin si Alex para sa akin?#$e#Salamat.

records.source: Your name is @, right?#$e#I keep forgetting.
records.translation: @ ang pangalan mo, tama?#$e#Lagi kong nalilimutan.

records.source: Hi @.#$e#Is anything exciting happening on your farm?
records.translation: Kumusta, @.#$e#May kapana-panabik bang nangyayari sa bukid mo?

records.source: I think I'm starting to realize that clothes aren't the most important thing. Right?#$e#I still like clothes, though. I mean, what's wrong with expressing yourself a little?
records.translation: Sa tingin ko'y nagsisimula kong mapagtantong hindi ang mga damit ang pinakamahalagang bagay. Hindi ba?#$e#Pero gusto ko pa rin ang mga damit. Ibig kong sabihin, ano ang masama sa kaunting pagpapahayag ng sarili?

records.source: Maybe I'll donate some of my skirts to a charity this spring.#$e#I mean, I do have over 1,000 skirts.$h#$e#...what?
records.translation: Baka ipamigay ko sa kawanggawa ang ilan sa mga palda ko ngayong tagsibol.#$e#Ibig kong sabihin, mahigit isang libong palda naman ang mayroon ako.$h#$e#...ano?

records.source: Um, if you see Alex could you tell him I'm busy today?#$e#Thanks.
records.translation: Um, kung makita mo si Alex, maaari mo bang sabihing abala ako ngayon?#$e#Salamat.

records.source: I wish it were warmer here in Stardew Valley.#$e#I could move somewhere else, but...
records.translation: Sana ay mas mainit dito sa Stardew Valley.#$e#Maaari akong lumipat sa ibang lugar, pero...

records.source: Do you think you'll ever have a pony on your farm?
records.translation: Sa tingin mo ba ay magkakaroon ka ng poni sa bukid mo?

records.source: I'm glad you have less work to do in the winter.#$e#It must be nice to have a break, huh?
records.translation: Natutuwa akong mas kaunti ang gawain mo sa taglamig.#$e#Siguradong masarap magkaroon ng pahinga, ano?

records.source: @, you look rugged today. I like it.^@, you look pretty today.#$e#...$h
records.translation: @, mukha kang matipuno ngayon. Gusto ko iyon.^@, napakaganda mo ngayon.#$e#...$h
